name: Trelium
long_description: Trelium lets enterprise teams build AI agents in simple English to automate back-office work. We serve companies handling custom and bulk operations, including distributors, suppliers, and decorators across the print, merch, and apparel industries, automating workflows like order entry, purchase order creation, PO-invoice matching, order-status follow-ups, and many more.
one_liner: AI Agents for Enterprise Wide Operations
